Bug report: with the `toc` extension, a heading like `# Hello world !` gets the id `hello-world-`, with a trailing dash. Fix it and add a regression test.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. report.answer: Fixed: `slugify` in the toc extension now trims spaces left over after removing punctuation, so `# Hello world !` gets the id `hello-world`. Added a regression test, which fails without the fix and passes with it, and a changelog entry; the full test suite passes.
